items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mattie Height, a girl that was with Cora Green and them down there at the Panama, she said to me... 'You go to New York, you belong in New York'

ctx.x: Always the greatest. It still is, I guess. Chicago was the greatest, yeah. And I tell you, you asked me how I happened to think about coming to New York, Mattie Height, a girl that was with Cora Green and them down there at the Panama, she said to me, said, 'Girl, you ain't got no business here; (unintelligible) you've got to go to brighter fields. You go to New York, you belong in New York, go on to New York.' And then I kind of made up my mind then, I believe I will go, you know. I made up my mind then. I said,…
You know, they talk so much now about women's lib and women -- career women, and so forth. It seems to me that back in those days there were a lot of women who were very independent and --
